units_searched.note: Graduate Degree Requirements (Academic Integrity section and Written Critique/WCP rules) state unit-wide AI rules. The 2023 edition bans AI writing tools and content-generation tools unless explicitly allowed; the 2025 edition allows generative AI for grammar/fluency, subject to class restrictions. The undergraduate page has no AI policy.

documents.title: Graduate Degree Requirements, Department of Computer Science, 2025
documents.quality_note: AI text is two short passages in a 100k-char handbook: the Academic Integrity 'Non-original work' standard (generative AI to improve writing, grammar and fluency, 'is not forbidden a priori, but may be further restricted in specific classes') and the WCP rule (an initial draft prior to AI use must be available to the committee). Graduate students only.

documents.title: Graduate Degree Requirements, Department of Computer Science, 2023
documents.quality_note: Earlier edition, probably superseded by 2025. States: 'you should not use paraphrasing software (like QuillBot) or AI software for writing (like ChatGPT) or any AI tools for content generation (spell-checkers are allowed), unless explicitly allowed to do so.' Repeated in the WCP rules. Shows the stance changed between editions.
